steps.title: Inspect and Verify the PSU
steps.subtitle: Inspect the Delta PSU and confirm its identity before testing.

items.text: Wear required PPE and ESD protection.
Remove the PSU from its ESD bag and inspect the unit, connector pins, and contacts for burns or damage.
If damaged, mark the location with a yellow arrow sticker and return it to ZTP without testing.
Scan the MRS ticket and serial number into OSV Portal.
Confirm the tag serial matches the PSU and verify the unit has not already been tested.

steps.warning: Do not test a damaged or previously tested PSU.

steps.title: Prepare the Delta Fixture
steps.subtitle: Connect the fixture and install the PSU in the approved order.

items.text: Insert the AC power cord into the fixture AC connection.
Turn on the fixture AC button.
Insert the fixture power cord.
Place the PSU on the fixture.
Connect the PSU using the handlebar.
Insert the power cord into the PSU.

steps.warning: Verify every connection is fully seated before applying PSU output power.

steps.title: Check the 12V Output
steps.subtitle: Verify the first green output indicator.

items.text: Turn on AC ON power.
Confirm the green 12V LED illuminates.
If the 12V LED does not illuminate, classify the PSU as failed and create a failed tag.

steps.warning: Do not continue to a pass decision when the 12V LED is off.

steps.title: Check the 54V Output
steps.subtitle: Verify both output indicators remain green for 30 seconds.

items.text: Turn on the 54V / PS ON power control.
Confirm the green 54V LED illuminates.
Observe both the 12V and 54V LEDs continuously for 30 seconds.
If both LEDs remain on, classify the PSU as good and mark it Passed.
If either LED is off, classify the PSU as failed and create a failed tag.

steps.warning: Both 12V and 54V indicators must stay green for the full 30-second observation.

steps.title: Inspect and Record the Result
steps.subtitle: Complete the required result documentation.

items.text: Inspect the PSU after testing to verify no damage was caused.
For test-related damage, notify OSV leadership, update OSV Portal, and create a physical-damage ticket.
Verify Name/ID, test date, PSU serial number, stock code GP-00061-001G, and detailed test result.
Use the actual failure reason, not only the word Failed.

steps.warning: All tag fields must be accurate.

steps.title: Package and Complete Shift Records
steps.subtitle: Return the PSU and provide MES evidence.

items.text: Place the ticket in the traveler sleeve.
Return the PSU to its matching ESD bag and place it on the ESD cart for ZTP pickup.
Export Test Lab Records from MES and filter to components tested during the shift.
Capture the list using Windows+Shift+S and post it in the Test Lab Records Check-in/out chat.
Verify ZTP closes the records by close of business the next day; request closure if needed.

steps.warning: Always verify the PSU is returned to the correct ESD bag.
